title: Butterflies – Junonia almana, 500 CFA francs
descriptionPlain: Description Coins designed for enthusiasts of the butterfly world Decorated with a lens that gives a magnifying effect Photographic quality digital printing This series combines the beauty of nature and the art of minting. Each coin presents an ephemeral portrait of a butterfly, capturing its colors and shapes with extraordinary precition. A limited edition, crafted with attention to every detail, using the highest grade silver, creates a perfect piece. These coins are designed for collectors and nature lovers, making a valuable addition to any collection and a way to celebrate the diversity of the butterfly world. They are also the perfect gift for thosewho appreciate uniqueness and elegance. The butterfly counts not months but moments, and has time enough. Rabindranath Tagore
